content:
deploy-bot: Rollout started 2245607890 — rollout id rl-78a, model=gptx-compact-v2, canary=5% -> staging(us-east-1). Config snapshot packed.

deploy-bot: config: {sticky_affinity: true, fallback: {type: variant, variant: gptx-legacy, scope: global}, routing_policy: smart-route} :rocket:

eva: seeing spike in 5xxs from the canary group around 14:02 UTC. errors ~12% of canary traffic, latency +250ms. attaching quick logs.

mike: @eva can you paste the error lines?

eva: logs excerpt:```
[2026-03-12T14:02:31Z] ERR req=abc123 ModelVariantMismatch: kvcache shape mismatch while loading gptx-legacy
[2026-03-12T14:02:32Z] ERR req=abc456 DownstreamError: remote-region call failed tls handshake
```

oncall-bot: :pager: oncall page issued for rl-78a: error_rate>10% for 5m — paging sre_pager.

sre_pager: taking this. quick dashboard look: error surge originates in us-west-2 and ap-southeast-1 despite the canary target being us-east-1. looks like fallback routing is spilling traffic cross-region.

sam: that sounds like sticky affinity is holding session routing to the legacy variant which happens to live in other regions, causing RPCs across regions. any recent infra changes?

eva: no infra changes aside from the rollout. rollout config copied from previous run but fallback.scope is set to global in the new template. snippet:```
rollout:
  id: rl-78a
  canary_pct: 5
  sticky_affinity: true
  fallback:
    type: variant
    variant: gptx-legacy
    scope: global
```

mike: my theory: sticky_affinity + global fallback means previously sticky sessions pinned to gptx-legacy in their original region are now being honored across regions when the canary is present, generating cross-region model loads and kvcache mismatches.

sre_pager: agreed. mitigation plan: 1) pause rollout, 2) change fallback.scope to region, 3) disable sticky_affinity for in-flight canary, 4) monitor.

jia: executing pause: `redwood rollout pause rl-78a` — acknowledged. (14:07 UTC)

deploy-bot: Rollout rl-78a paused at 2245610020 by jia.

sre_pager: applying policy patch now:
```
redwood policy patch rl-78a --set fallback.scope=region --set sticky_affinity=false
```

sam: policy patch applied. watching metrics.

eva: error rate dropping — down to ~1.1% after ~4m. latency back to baseline.

mike: good. customer impact quick estimate: ~6% of requests routed through affected variants in APAC had errors; some customer-facing integrations reported degraded responses for ~12 minutes total. recommending severity move from P1->P2 post-mitigation.

jia: filed INC-2026-1456, added timeline + affected customers + screenshots. tagging support for comms.

support-bot: Triage note added to INC-2026-1456. Suggested comms draft created in doc: //docs/support/incidents/INC-2026-1456-draft.md

sre_pager: root cause summary: interaction between sticky_affinity=true and fallback.scope=global allowed legacy variant affinity to be honored across regions, causing cross-region model variant loads and kvcache incompatibilities.

sre_pager: follow-ups: 1) add guard in rollout controller to disallow global fallbacks when sticky_affinity is true, 2) add e2e test for kvcache compat across variants, 3) run audit for active rollouts with global fallback+sticky_affinity, 4) create runbook step to pause on cross-region error spikes.

mike: taking post-incident action items. handing off to night oncall. @jia please include the policy patch diff and exact timeline in the ticket.

jia: will do.

sre_pager: handing off to @mike for overnight monitoring — leaving incident in monitoring state.

mike: ack. will follow up in morning and schedule a short postmortem if trend resurfaces.

support-bot: Incident state updated -> monitoring.

sam: note for runbook: consider defaulting fallback.scope to region for any variant-based fallback unless explicitly opted-in.

mike: noted. last check-in timestamp 2245611490.
